news.title: Anthropic秘密提交IPO申请
news.snippet: AI初创企业Anthropic秘密递交首次公开募股（IPO）申请，拟进军公开市场融资。
news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence • IPO • Public Markets • Startups • Venture. Anthropic said Monday that it has submitted a confidential filing for a proposed IPO. For its most recent funding round, a $65 billion Series H funding announced last week, the San Francisco company more than doubled its post-money valuation to a staggering $965 billion. The IPO filing marks an escalation in the race among generative AI behemoths to make it first to the public market. After that, it will need to submit its public filing, carry out its pre-IPO roadshow, and put the remaining pieces in place for an offering of this presumed magnitude. Before that, however, will be the public filing of its IPO prospectus, which will offer a long-awaited peek under the hood at Anthropic’s famously fast revenue growth and the scope of the capital expenditures it has taken to get there. * Global Venture Funding To AI Startups In 2026.
